title: PAUSE SCRIM AND KEYS INTRO
why: Critic c-31: the HUD showed through the pause card, and the Keys window opened with an explaining sentence. The scrim goes to 97 percent and the sentence is hidden. Pause title and legend sizes stay as the old checks pin them.
now: The pause screen covers the HUD behind it, and the Keys window opens straight on the list.

edits.replacement: #root #setdetail .sdh{ font-size:var(--fs-body); line-height:1.5; }   /* v28.xx (cw-pausescrim) critic c-31 (pause 2, keys 2): the HUD showed through the pause card, and the Keys window opened with an explaining sentence above the list */ #root #pausebox{ background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ui-void) 97%,transparent); } #root #keysmodal .msub{ display:none; }
